question: In SH, what is the total SALES.AMOUNT_SOLD for calendar 1998, joining SALES to TIMES by TIME_ID? Round to two decimal places and display exactly two fractional digits without thousands separators.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(s.amount_sold),2),'FM999999999990.00') FROM sh.sales s JOIN sh.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id WHERE t.calendar_year=1998
